## Claim · R34 · `domain:devx` execution seat

- **Claim:** session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC` · **Branch:** `claude/issue-11668-delete-behavior-suggestion-text` · **Tier:** `sonnet`
- **Declared file surface:** `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` (the `relationship/delete-behavior` message string). ⭐ Free.
- **Clause ②:** no. **Governed surface:** no ⇒ armable once green.

### ⭐ Triage's unlock condition, EXECUTED before dispatch rather than assumed

The 2026-08-24 triage note set the test: *"on #9689's close, **grep the suggestion text on the merged ref** — if the string survives, this is a one-line text fix …; if it's gone, close as absorbed."*

**Run against `origin/main`:**

```
packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:607:
  message: `master_detail "…" → ${parent} should declare deleteBehavior (cascade/restrict/set_null)`
```
control: `deleteBehavior` hits **4×** in the same file ⇒ the grep works, and the survival is real.

⇒ **The string survives. The work is genuinely undone.** ⭐ This seat dispatched already-finished work earlier today (#12846) for want of exactly this check; it is not skipping it twice.

### Zone 1 — ⛔ not re-litigable

- `deleteBehavior: 'set_null'` on a `master_detail` has been a **named parse-time rejection** since PR #11406 (#9689, maintainer ruling 2026-08-19). ⇒ the suggestion, followed literally, **walks an author into a publish-time error.**
- **Only the message enumeration is stale.** The `fix` payload (`'cascade'`) is correct — ⛔ do not change it.
- ⛔ **The rule itself is healthy and must not be touched.** It consumes RAW authored objects (`lintDataModel(objects: any[])`), where absent has always meant "not authored" — verified in the card against `packages/cli/test/data-model-rules.test.ts`, which passes raw literals. #9689's idempotent-materialization change does not reach it.

### Zone 2 — 须实测,鼓励证伪

- I believe the correct enumeration is **`cascade`/`restrict`** for `master_detail`. **Verify against #9689's ruled vocabulary and the parser's actual reject list** — ⛔ do not take my two values on faith; the ruling's spelling is the authority.
- I believe this is one string. If the same stale enumeration appears elsewhere in `packages/lint`, fix those too and say so; ⛔ but do not widen into `#11409` (skill docs) or `#11410` (field designer form) — those are **separate cards with their own fix sites.**

### ⛔ Fences

⛔ No rule-logic change · ⛔ no `packages/spec` edits · ⛔ never `git stash` (`refs/stash` is shared across worktrees) · worktree-first.
⚠️ **A green derived gate family is NOT a green CI** — unconditional steps are not derived. Run `check:pm-dispatch-gates` by hand as well.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #13668

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`, R34 review.

### The change

`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:607` — the `relationship/delete-behavior` suggestion no longer offers `set_null` as a declarable value on a `master_detail`:

- **before** — `… should declare deleteBehavior (cascade/restrict/set_null)`
- **after** — `… should declare deleteBehavior (cascade/restrict — set_null is not honored on master_detail; use a lookup field if children must survive the parent)`

### ⭐ Why this is accepted on evidence rather than on the report

The dev did not take this seat's dispatch premise on trust. It went and found **two independent authorities** for the corrected enumeration and named them. **This seat then re-verified both directly on `origin/main` rather than accepting the report** — a dev's report is evidence, not a conclusion:

| authority | reading (verified by this seat) |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1053-1054` | *"where an AUTHORED `set_null` on a `master_detail` is a named parse-time rejection"* |
| `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts:200-206` | comment *"`master_detail`: no `set_null` … the schema refuses the combination outright (#9689)"*, and the `master_detail` select options are **exactly** `cascade` + `restrict` |

⇒ Both agree, and the new message's vocabulary matches the surface an author actually meets. The old text walked an author into a publish-time 422 by naming a value the parse door rejects.

⭐ The message also keeps the **outcome-naming courtesy** of the rejection message itself — it still says the word `set_null`, in order to say plainly that it is *not honored here* and where to go instead (`lookup`). That is better than silently dropping the value, which would leave an author who had already written `set_null` with no explanation.

### Review points checked

- ✅ **Scope held.** Rule logic (`def.deleteBehavior === undefined`) and the `fix` payload (`deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`) untouched, per Zone 1. Did not widen into #11409 / #11410.
- ✅ **Completeness verified, not assumed.** The dev grepped `packages/lint` for `set_null` / `deleteBehavior` and established this was the only stale site.
- ✅ **The fix is pinned.** No pre-existing test asserted the message text (the CLI test only checked `severity === 'suggestion'`), so an unpinned fix would have been free to rot back. The dev added two assertions — and notably asserted the **declarable set** (`not.toContain('cascade/restrict/set_null')` + `toContain('(cascade/restrict')`) rather than a bare absence of the substring `set_null`, which would have wrongly forbidden the explanatory mention. That is the right shape of assertion for this change.
- ✅ **No governed-surface path** in the diff (`.changeset/`, `packages/cli/test/`, `packages/lint/src/`) and **no `packages/spec/**` path** ⇒ clause ② not engaged.
- ✅ Changeset present and accurate, `@objectstack/lint` patch.

### Zone 2 outcome
Both stated assumptions were **confirmed, with evidence, not assumed** — the corrected enumeration, and "this is the only stale occurrence in `packages/lint`".

### Carried out of scope, correctly
The dev hit the `pnpm --filter '<pkg>^...' build` failure and **declined to file blind** when its dup-check was rate-limited. This seat ran the dup-check by repo-scoped enumeration (3,345 issues, `#6734..#13672`) — it is a duplicate of the open **#13513**, so the observation was added there as a third sighting, together with a candidate mechanism verified on `origin/main`. ⛔ No duplicate card filed.

Arming once the last check settles.
